features.name: Browse Japanese homes in English
features.description: Every listing is presented in English — title, description, address layer, property type — while the original Japanese is kept underneath for use with local agents.
features.notes: Bilingual *_ja/*_en storage; UI offers EN / 日本語 / Both toggle. 1,865 live listings.

features.name: Filter & slice inventory
features.description: Narrow listings by property type, price (JPY or USD), prefecture, region, build year, floor area, bedrooms, seismic code, akiya-bank-only, and free-text keyword.
features.notes: queries.search_listings + GET /listings; cheapest-first ordering, price-on-request listings kept.

features.name: Akiya / Kominka / rural focus
features.description: Property types tuned for foreign buyers: vacant house (akiya), traditional kominka, modern house, apartment, commercial, farmhouse, and land.
features.notes: modern 909, akiya 647, land 133, kominka 65, farmhouse 64, commercial 46, apartment 1.

features.name: USD <-> JPY price view
features.description: Prices shown and filtered in either Japanese yen or US dollars, converted at a configurable rate.
features.notes: usd_jpy_rate setting (default 155); applied in queries, matching, notifications.

features.name: Prefecture choropleth
features.description: A full 47-prefecture map of Japan shaded by how many live listings each prefecture has, so hotspots are obvious at a glance.
features.notes: folium GeoJson choropleth; 46 prefectures currently carry listings.

features.name: Clustered price pins
features.description: Each geocoded home drops a pin showing price, photo, type, size and a link straight to the original listing; nearby pins cluster so towns stay readable.
features.notes: MarkerCluster; 1,171 listings geocoded; deterministic jitter separates co-located homes.

features.name: English / Japanese / satellite / hazard layers
features.description: Switch between English labels, Japanese labels, GSI satellite and topographic maps, and overlay MLIT flood, landslide, tsunami and storm-surge hazard layers.
features.notes: Esri + CartoDB + GSI tiles; 4 disaster-portal hazard overlays toggleable.

features.name: Region to prefecture to city drill-down
features.description: Pick a region, then a prefecture, then a city to zoom and filter the map and listing grid together.
features.notes: mapview.build_map(region, pref_slug) + cities_for(); city-level GeoJSON is a future add.

features.name: Saved search Profiles
features.description: Describe what you want once — type, budget, area, size, era, seismic, keywords — and save it as a named Profile instead of re-searching every day.
features.notes: Multi-profile; 3 active profiles in the DB. criteria_json holds optional ranges/sets.

features.name: Automatic match-on-ingest
features.description: As new listings arrive, each is scored against every active Profile and recorded as a match — the engine watches the market for you.
features.notes: 203 matches recorded; runs inside the ingest transaction.

features.name: Relevance scoring
features.description: Matches are ranked by fit: cheaper-vs-ceiling listings and those hitting soft preferences (climate, keywords) score higher.
features.notes: score 0..1 = 0.5*price-headroom + 0.5*soft-pref hit-rate.

features.name: On-demand profile pull
features.description: Force a live scrape of just one Profile's target prefectures right now, then re-match — rather than waiting for the next scheduled cycle.
features.notes: pipeline.pull_for_profile() routes akiya-bank vs SUUMO sources by property type.

features.name: Scheduled digests per Profile
features.description: Map each Profile to a Daily, Weekly, Monthly or custom-cron cadence; the engine bundles new matches into a digest on that schedule.
features.notes: APScheduler CronTrigger, Asia/Tokyo timezone; per-profile schedules table.

features.name: Daily new-house update
features.description: A daily summary of every house newly added in the last 24 hours, regardless of profile.
features.notes: build_daily_digest(window_hours=24) at 08:00 JST.

features.name: On-site notification inbox
features.description: Digests land in an in-app notifications panel with read/unread tracking — no email account required.
features.notes: notifications table; 3 recorded; GET /notifications + mark-read.

features.name: Email digests
features.description: Optionally send the same digests to your inbox via local SMTP.
features.notes: Built; email_enabled=0 by default — needs SMTP user + SMTP_PASSWORD env to activate.

features.name: Seismic & era flags
features.description: Each home is tagged with its building era (Showa/Heisei/Reiwa) and seismic code class (pre-1981 Kyu-Taishin vs post-1981 Shin-Taishin) — a critical risk signal for old Japanese houses.
features.notes: Derived from build_year in normalize.py.

features.name: Renovation cost estimate
features.description: A rough renovation budget is auto-estimated from building area and property type, so a cheap akiya's true cost is visible up front.
features.notes: estimate_reno(): ~90k yen/sqm for akiya/kominka/farmhouse, 50k otherwise.

features.name: Listing detail enrichment
features.description: Opening a listing pulls extra detail from the source page: photo gallery, full spec table (price/tsubo, coverage ratio, utilities, land category), days-on-market, and nearest station.
features.notes: enrich.py parses at-home detail pages; 915 listings carry photos.

features.name: Hazard exposure (map overlays)
features.description: Cross-reference any area against official MLIT flood, landslide, tsunami and storm-surge maps before buying.
features.notes: Map overlays live; per-listing hazard_json column reserved but not yet populated.

features.name: Registered QI project
features.description: AkiyaScout is a registered QI ecosystem project with allocated ports and a documented interface contract.
features.notes: qi_registry.json: api 8505, ui 7845, family_tier cousin.

features.name: Standard QI API contract
features.description: Exposes the standard /health, /version, /info endpoints every QI service implements, plus its own listings/profiles/ingest surface.
features.notes: api/main.py; CORS from qi_registry with safe fallback.

features.name: Always-on Windows service + public tunnel
features.description: Run AkiyaScout 24/7 as a QI_ NSSM service and reach it remotely via a tunnel.
features.notes: Currently launched via Start_AkiyaScout.bat; no QI_AkiyaScout service registered yet.

features.name: QI Brain cross-project memory
features.description: Log Scout sessions and decisions to the QI Brain for ecosystem-wide visibility.
features.notes: Not yet wired; integrates_with is empty in the registry.
